extension.name: RSB Member Code (Shopify)
extension.author: Raydraws, L.L.C.
extension.description: Shows the current members-only Shopify discount code. Codes rotate on a fixed schedule: each period's code is worked out from a shared secret, and the morning check creates the matching code in Shopify ahead of time. Set this module's Access to Members.

field.name: secret
field.label: Code secret
field.description: Same value as ops/member-code-secret.txt. Never share it.

field.name: terms
field.label: Terms
field.default: $15 off when you buy 2 or more items at shop.raydraws.com. One use per customer.
